top_signals.title: US Diesel Prices Climb to Highest Since Mid-2022
top_signals.summary:
US retail diesel prices hit a four-year high, topping a peak seen during the early stages of the Iran war to approach a record. The national average pump price climbed to $5.783 a gallon on Wednesday, according to the American Automobile Association. Bloomberg's Anthony di Paola reports.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Zelenskyy Fires Secret Service Official After Kyiv Shootout
top_signals.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy dismissed a department head at the country’s security service following a shootout between officers from two rival intelligence agencies on the streets of Kyiv on Wednesday.
